comments.text:
Created standard agent rules in context/agents.md:
- 7 development agents: database-dev, ai-dev, integration-dev, search-dev, automation-dev, testing-dev, debugger  
- Bead lifecycle rules (never start without bead, always update progress, close with commit hash)
- Domain boundaries with handoff requirements
- Session management with mandatory git push

Created database-dev agent context with:
- Domain ownership and boundaries
- Core patterns from specs/001 (multi-tenant, vector, migrations)  
- Performance contracts and testing patterns
- Handoff conditions to other agents

Next: Create remaining agent contexts (ai-dev, integration-dev, etc.)
